case.presentation: Incidental solid pulmonary nodule, 5 mm, right upper lobe, on a chest CT performed for unrelated abdominal trauma evaluation.
case.context: Routine CT abdomen/pelvis after MVA; lung bases included the nodule incidentally. Patient asymptomatic, no known pulmonary disease.

ground_truth.notes: Canonical low-risk small solid nodule. Anchor case for the NO_ROUTINE_FOLLOWUP bin.
